Each analytical figure is generated with image, DOCX, and CSV companions. Publication figures also supply PDF/SVG and separate panel PNGs. Multipanel DOCX uses one panel image per borderless cell and a separate panel-letter row.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(SIECCLongWeather)
run_demo()
```
